title: The barrow-field clasp and the widow's-well locket both read as important plot-clue items (matching the elder's coffer, and the MAREN name later paid off at the Drowned Hall) but only one of the two (the locket) actually persisted as a real, later-relevant item — the clasp's promise fizzled, which undercuts trust in similar-feeling item finds elsewhere.
